children: US spot Ether exchange-traded funds recorded net inflows for a sixth straight trading session.
SoSoValue data showed the funds brought in a combined $86.95 million on September 25.

drew another $31.88 million. Together, the two products attracted $82.25 million, or about 95% of the day's total net inflows.

ETHA's cumulative net inflows increased to $13.28 billion. Cumulative net inflows for FETH and Grayscale's ETH stood at $2.42 billion and $2.03 billion, respectively. By contrast, Grayscale's ETHE has seen cumulative net outflows of $5.41 billion since launch.

title: US Spot Ether ETFs Post $87 Million in Net Inflows, Extending Streak to Six Sessions
